partially_covered.missing: Ontology provides Organization and Address, but lacks explicit properties for detailed participant info (e.g., contact details, legal name, registration info).
Item class is present, but lacks detailed properties (e.g., item description, SKU, unit of measure).
Invoice details are distributed across sections and segments, but no explicit grouping or summary property.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are addressed through the class/property structure. Partial gaps exist for participant and item details, and invoice detail aggregation.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Comprehensive use of restrictions and cardinality
Functional and inverse properties well defined
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalence axioms for complex class definitions
Limited enrichment for item and organization details

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7 (No equivalence axioms for key classes)
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet may slow down on complex restrictions but no datatype violations detected

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization and Item classes with additional data properties (e.g., organization legal name, registration number, item description, SKU, unit of measure) to fully cover CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves CQ coverage and semantic richness for business document queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and owl:equivalentClass definitions for classes like InvoiceMessage, DetailSection, and RoleAssignment to clarify necessary and sufficient conditions.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer axiomatization, better reasoning support, improved validator scores.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit union/disjoint union axioms for Section subclasses to clarify invoice structure.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Cleaner hierarchy, improved clarity for validators and reasoners.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add temporal properties (e.g., effectiveDate, dueDate) using xsd:dateTime for invoices and line items.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports advanced queries and business process modeling.

summary: The ontology is well-structured, with deep hierarchies and comprehensive coverage for most competency questions. It adheres to OWL 2 DL constraints and includes rich property characteristics and restrictions. Improvements are needed for participant/item detail enrichment and advanced axiomatization, but overall quality and coverage are high.
